result_text:
In `ScopingConventions.java` (`addTestConventions`), I changed the two mock-folder patterns so they match any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock`:

- `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\\- ]+/.*` is now `.*/__mock[^/]*/.*`
- `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\\- ]+/.*` is now `.*/mock[^/]*/.*`

The new patterns cover plain `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/`, `mock-größe/` and `mock模拟/`. The `[^/]*` keeps the match inside one folder name, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` stay out. The earlier cases (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`) still match.

The path filter already normalises backslashes to `/` before matching (`SourceFileFilter.pathMatches`), so Windows-style paths work without a separate pattern.

I ran `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='*Convention*'`, and it passed. That run only covers existing tests. I didn't add tests for the new cases or check them directly. Nothing is committed.
